notes: Carthage Avenue: name printed on the north-south part (x~9560) and again at the bottom left (x~7050, y~6300); the diagonal between them is lettered only AVENUE and carries the same car track, so I call it all Carthage Avenue. Railroad Avenue: the 50 ft strip north of the tracks, lettered RAILROAD near x 7650 and AVENUE near x 9350. Bank Avenue (y~2090) is only about 30 ft wide here; its name is read from the label BANK at x~6550, outside the strip. Five-way junction near (9550,2760): Carthage Avenue from the north bends onto the diagonal; a street runs south from it (label cut by plate edge, ends ...T AVE., recorded ? at 9549,2763); a stub runs east from (9550,2807) (unnamed here, only pipe/sewer lettering) and another stub ENE at (9553,2700); all cut by the plate edge. Phillips Avenue does NOT reach that junction: it bends south-east at (9180,2797) and joins Carthage Avenue at (9341,2951); the grey-tinted strip north of Phillips (old canal/right of way; Canal Street abuts it) is not a street. Unnamed stubs on the east/south-east side of Carthage Avenue, all cut by the plate edge, names not legible: (9677,500) O..., (9579,943) C..., (8526,3710), (7867,4357) B..., (7432,4965) O..., (7147,6153). Bottom junction (6981,6970): Carthage Avenue continues south as a ... St. (label cut), a street with a 16 in. water pipe enters from the WNW and a stub leaves ENE (C...); recorded as one cross with ?. Lawrence Street jogs at Martin Street: north leg centre x 7654, south leg x 7698; one crossing recorded at the midpoint. Ludlow Avenue (north of West Ross) and Andrews Street (south of it) are offset about 20 px, recorded as two T junctions. East Ross Avenue meets Carthage about 30 px north of West Ross. Beech Avenue crosses the tracks between Railroad Avenue and its southern leg (10 in. sewer drawn through). No street at x~8540 south of Bank Avenue (lot 13 with a yellow boundary band).
